title: The Godfather: Offers & Refusals
description: Power, family, and cinema’s most unforgettable offers—five Godfather depths.

questions.question: Which director spent The Godfather's shoot convinced Paramount was about to fire him?
questions.explanation: He says he nearly got fired three or four times. What saved him? Winning the Patton screenplay Oscar mid-shoot. Scorsese asked, "How are they going to fire you now?"

questions.question: Coppola's Don Vito tells his godson Johnny Fontane, "I'm gonna make him..." what?
questions.explanation: Michael later explains how it works: Luca Brasi held a gun to a bandleader's head, and the Don promised "either his brains or his signature would be on the contract."

questions.question: When Hollywood mogul Jack Woltz refuses the Don's offer, what does he wake up to find in his bed?
questions.explanation: Tom Hagen left Woltz's dinner early, explaining that Mr. Corleone "insists on hearing bad news immediately." The Don's reply arrived by morning.

questions.question: That horse's head came from Woltz's prized stallion. What was its name?
questions.explanation: Woltz proudly shows him off to Hagen and says he won't race him: "I'm gonna put him out to stud." The horse shares its name with Sudan's capital.

questions.question: Woltz boasts that Khartoum is how much money "on four hooves"?
questions.explanation: "I'll bet Russian czars never paid that kind of dough for a single horse," Woltz brags. His pride showed the Don exactly where to hit him.

easterEgg.title: The cat was never in the script
easterEgg.text: Coppola spotted a stray on set and dropped it in Brando's lap without a word. It purred so loudly that the Don's lines had to be re-recorded, and you can still hear it on the soundtrack.
